## Historical Task Snapshot
None.

## Goal
To maintain a consolidated, up-to-date record of configuration values, operational parameters, and team settings across multiple projects (Aurora, Umbra, Lyra, Nimbus, Ember, Flint, Yukon, Velvet, Fjord, Ursa, Onyx, Yarrow, Rune, Thistle, Zenith, Alder, Juniper, Iris, Nova, Lumen, Jasper, Opal, Quill) and hosts (Cedar, Rune), including handling scope-specific exceptions (staging, canary, hotfix, weekends, Fridays, mobile API, intern cohorts).

## Constraints & Preferences
- "Large log files should be summarized, not pasted."
- "User reads documentation in English but chats in Korean."
- "User usually works late in the evening."
- "User dislikes emoji in commit messages."
- "Avoid force-pushing to shared branches."
- "Run 'make test' before pushing any branch."
- "Prefer small pull requests with clear titles."
- "Note that the GPU queue of Cedar overrides the IP with 10.106.230.108."
- "Lesson learned: the office VPN only works with MTU 4143."
- "Jira tickets for infra work go to board 8939."
- "Grafana dashboard #4024 is the one with the cluster health overview."
- "Shared lab printer is in room 5743."

## Completed Actions

2. CONFIGURED Cedar: SSH port set to 3488, IP address 10.193.60.28, swap size 910 GB; proposal to move SSH port to 9112 rejected.
